name: airzoo-client-install
description: Install and set up the AirZoo rendering client on Windows: clone repo, create conda env airzoo, copy AirSim settings.json, download UE engine from Hugging Face, and run a test render. Use when the user asks to install, set up, or configure AirZoo, AirZooClient, the AirZoo renderer, conda environment, or first-time rendering on Windows.
